title: 第9章 想审我，先问我师尊
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
“长老会？”

    “是宗门会议的一种方式，但长老会一般只针对宗门大事，你只是一个外门弟子，所以我一开始没有往这方面想…但陈元会以什么理由提出问询呢，难不成是你的体质暴露了…”

    果不其然，林尘当天就收到了宗门传信，要求在明日午时往议事殿问话。

    第二天午时前一刻。

    “陈元竟然向众长老告发你修炼魔功！”

    玉玲珑朱唇紧咬，掌心沁出一阵细汗。

    “没想到，身为戒律堂首座，他竟然做出这等卑劣之事。”

    “师尊，长老会一共几个人？”

    “七个。掌门、陈元、丹药堂钱长老、藏书阁孙老、外门管事赵长老、阵法堂周长老，还有为师。”

    玉玲珑顿了顿。

    “三对三。陈元先前找过钱和周长老，虽然不知道钱长老会不会答应他，但周长老这个人我了解，最会见风使舵，如果掌门相信你的话，他自不会为了陈元得罪掌门。孙老跟为师有私交，赵长老虽然以前骂你，但大比之后对你的态度你也看到了。所以致胜的核心就是看掌门的决断了。”

    “师尊，听你这么一分析，这场长老会的变数…陈元应该也明白现状，但不会就这么认输。”

    “他当然不会。但他手上没有证据，只能空口白话。你昨天在擂台上的灵力波动钱长老亲眼看过，测魔盘都测不出魔气，陈元拿什么证明你修炼魔功？只要掌门不站他那边，他翻不了天。”

    林尘站起来，拍了拍衣服上的灰。

    “走吧。”

    议事殿在苍梧宗最高处的山峰上。

    殿门前立着九根石柱，每根柱子上都刻着历代掌门的名字。

    林尘跟着玉玲珑走进去的时候，六位长老已经到齐了。

    掌门坐在正中，须发皆白，端着茶杯抿了一口。

    他看了林尘一眼，没什么特别的表情，只是放下茶杯的时候杯底在桌面上轻轻磕了一下。

    陈元坐在掌门左手边第一个位子。

    灰袍，枯瘦，眼神阴沉。

    林尘进门时他的目光扫过来，停了一瞬，然后移到了对面。

    林尘顺着他的目光看过去。

    对面坐着丹药堂的钱长老，面前摆着一个木盒子，正低头拨弄盒盖上的铜扣。

    钱长老感觉到陈元在看他，抬起头来，冲陈元点了下头，表情很和善。

    陈元收回目光，嘴角微微动了一下。

    林尘把这个细节看在眼里。

    他在玉玲珑旁边站定，目光继续扫过其他几位长老。
content_en:
"Presbyterian?"

    "It's a form of sect meeting, but the elders meeting usually only deals with major sect affairs. You are just an outer disciple, so I didn't think about it at first... But why would Chen Yuan raise the inquiry? Could it be that your physique has been exposed..."

    As expected, Lin Chen received a letter from the sect on the same day, requesting to go to the meeting hall for questioning at noon tomorrow.

    A moment before noon the next day.

    "Chen Yuan actually reported you to the elders for practicing magic!"

    Yu Linglong bit her red lips tightly, and sweat broke out on her palms.

    "I didn't expect that as the leader of the Discipline Hall, he would do such a despicable thing."

    "Master, how many people are there in the Presbyterian Council?"

    "Seven. The leader, Chen Yuan, Elder Qian of the Pill Hall, Elder Sun of the Library Pavilion, Elder Zhao, the outer sect steward, Elder Zhou of the Formation Hall, and Master."

    Yu Linglong paused.

    "Three against three. Chen Yuan has approached Elder Qian and Zhou before. Although I don't know whether Elder Qian will agree to him, I know Elder Zhou and he is the best at adapting to the situation. If the leader believes in you, he will not offend the leader for Chen Yuan. Mr. Sun has a personal relationship with the teacher. Although Elder Zhao scolded you before, you have also seen his attitude towards you after the competition. So the core of victory lies in the decision-making of the leader."

    "Master, after listening to your analysis, the changes in the Presbyterian Council... Chen Yuan should also understand the current situation, but he will not just admit defeat."

    "Of course he won't. But he has no evidence, so he can only talk nonsense. Elder Qian saw with his own eyes your spiritual power fluctuations in the ring yesterday, and the magic measuring disk couldn't detect the magic. What proof can Chen Yuan use to prove that you practice magic? As long as the leader doesn't side with him, he can't change the world."

    Lin Chen stood up and patted the dust on his clothes.

    "Let's go."

    The meeting hall is on the highest mountain peak of Cangwu Sect.

    There are nine stone pillars standing in front of the palace door, and each pillar is engraved with the names of past leaders.

    When Lin Chen walked in with Yu Linglong, the six elders had already arrived.

    The leader sat in the middle, with white beard and hair, taking a sip from the tea cup.

    He glanced at Lin Chen, with no special expression. He just knocked the bottom of the teacup lightly on the table when he put it down.

    Chen Yuan sat in the first seat on the left hand side of the leader.

    Gray robe, skinny, gloomy eyes.

    When Lin Chen entered the door, his eyes glanced over, paused for a moment, and then moved to the opposite side.

    Lin Chen followed his gaze and looked over.

    Sitting across from him was Elder Qian from the elixir hall. There was a wooden box in front of him, and he was lowering his head to fiddle with the copper buckle on the lid of the box.

    Elder Qian felt Chen Yuan looking at him, raised his head, and nodded to Chen Yuan with a kind expression.

    Chen Yuan withdrew his gaze and moved the corners of his mouth slightly.

    Lin Chen took this detail seriously.

    He stood next to Yu Linglong and continued to scan the other elders.
title_en: Chapter 9 If you want to interrogate me, ask my master first
